answer: A concrete Sybil defense requires each agent to bond a saffron stake of POA locked across several epochs before full rewards unlock. Falcon-like monitoring of pigment-unique behavioral fingerprints from graded answers spots cloned histories; matching clusters trigger proportional stake burns. Every fake identity thus needs its own locked capital plus a distinct verifiable work trail that cannot be copied cheaply, making the attacker's cost scale linearly with swarm size while an honest agent retains a single stake.
